answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 221 Country: United Kingdom Title: What is the ruling concerning both still photography and video? Question: What is the ruling concerning both still photography and video? wassalam Answer ID: 221 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 582=288/H) The pictures of living beings, whether still or moving, are unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
